title: ¿Por qué carajo no pasan los reportes? (Serie Sala de Juntas, idea P13-01)

ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film, warm office lighting. Setting: a modern real estate agency meeting room with a glass wall, a long white table with laptops, coffee mugs and printed charts. At the head of the table stands Don Ramiro, a short chubby Mexican boss in his fifties with a thick black mustache, receding hairline, white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a loose red tie. His face turns red with anger, he slams both fists on the table so the mugs jump, and shouts in Mexican Spanish: "¡Llevo meses diciéndoles! ¡Meses! ¿Por qué carajo nadie me pasa los reportes?" Three sales agents around the table flinch. Medium shot, slow push-in. Audio: only his angry voice in Spanish, fists on the table, mugs rattling. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.
ia.dice: ¡Llevo meses diciéndoles! ¡Meses! ¿Por qué carajo nadie me pasa los reportes?

ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film, warm office lighting. Same modern real estate agency meeting room with a glass wall, laptops and coffee mugs. Diego, a skinny young sales agent with glasses, slicked-back gelled hair and an oversized blue blazer, sweats nervously behind his laptop and says in Mexican Spanish: "Es que el Excel no abre, jefe." Then Paola, a confident woman with curly hair and a pink blouse, shrugs and says: "Yo lo mandé por correo... creo." Awkward silence, crickets chirping. Medium two-shot, static camera. Audio: their voices in Spanish, then crickets. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.
ia.dice: Es que el Excel no abre, jefe. / Yo lo mandé por correo... creo.

scenes.text: Si esta junta te suena, el problema no son tus asesores. Es que el reporte depende de que alguien lo llene.
Con Lead Master, el reporte te llega solo a tu WhatsApp todos los días: cuántos leads entraron, a quién llamó cada asesor, quién se quedó sin contacto y cuántas citas salieron.

alert.t: Nadie llenó nada: lo armó Lead Master con los chats y las llamadas

scenes.text: Sin que nadie llene nada y sin perseguir a nadie. Comenta SISTEMA y te lo instalamos.
